ledger: Waitress (server) | gray hair in bun, light-blue polo, white apron, eyeglasses hanging at collar; behind counter wiping | same wardrobe/accessories at end; last seen rising from stool and as second instance near coffee station | wipes counter at night (00:11-00:18), pours coffee (00:25-00:32), wipes near kitchen pass (00:45-00:51), serves/clears plate (01:10-01:17), moves from behind counter to sit on customer side beside man (~01:20-01:35), watches man leave at window (01:46-01:50), duplicated at 01:52-01:56

Male customer | graying hair, stubble, brown work jacket over plaid shirt, blue jeans; enters diner ~00:20 | same wardrobe at end; walks out to truck 01:42-01:50 | enters at night, sits at counter near kitchen end (00:25), served coffee and plate, still seated at dawn (00:45-00:51) and morning (01:00-01:26), sits with waitress (01:27-01:35), pays with cash (01:38-01:40), exits

findings.description: Within one continuous shot, two instances of the waitress appear simultaneously: a semi-transparent copy wiping the counter near the kitchen pass and a solid copy rising from the stool and working at the coffee station on the right. Both move independently for ~5 seconds (01:52-01:57) before merging into one figure, which is too long for a dissolve and is not explained by any cut; the same character occupies two places at once.

The dawn cutaway (00:52-00:59) shows the counter and stools completely empty, yet the man was seated at the counter in the preceding shot (00:45-00:51, visible in background) and is seated again at the same counter in the following shot (01:00). No exit or movement is shown to account for his absence in the intervening shot.

The counter is shown entirely empty at 01:36-01:37 even though the previous shot (01:27-01:35) has both characters seated together at the counter and the next shot (01:38) has the man's hands placing cash beside his mug at that counter. Both characters vanish and reappear with no on-screen movement to explain it.
